area: B45 menu trail budget (PlatformProfile Desktop/MobileHigh, MenuCrystalClickHandler)
summary: The lava lamp's trail wait now has its own budget (lavaLampCellPrismBudget/Resume: 20,000/19,700 Desktop, 15,000/14,700 MobileHigh); freestyleCellPrismBudget on those tiers is back to 0. Sharing the freestyle budget lifted the Toy Box pen on PC once a cell held 20,000 prisms; far from the cell nothing grazed it back down, so the Squirrel/Manta trail stopped for good (Caleb and Yash both hit it). The lava-lamp B45 fix is kept as you built it.
